stashDiscover (Discover -> Overview)
=====================================

ssd.js, discover.js and stashdiscover.css come from the plugin stashDiscover 2.5.5 by ufousox007:
https://github.com/k6cc/stash-jav-tools/tree/main/stashDiscover

They are used in Stash UI with the author's permission. The changes for Stash UI are listed at the top of ssd.js and discover.js
(no React shell, stash-box questions through Stash UI's backend, settings in Stash UI's plugin config, Jackett / downloader through
backend modes). stashui-compat.css is Stash UI's own: it draws the Stash classes (cards, tables, popovers) the original leaves to Stash.
